data.one_liner: Generates REST clients and data classes from OpenAPI definition files or links.
data.what_it_does: Parses OpenAPI v2, v3.0, and v3.1 definitions in JSON or YAML formats to automatically generate Retrofit-based REST clients and data classes. Supports multiple serializers like json_serializable, freezed, and dart_mappable, as well as multi-language generation for Dart and Kotlin.
use_when: You want to automate the generation of data models and API clients from an OpenAPI schema
You are using Retrofit for networking and need boilerplate reduction
You work with multiple API definitions or microservices defined via OpenAPI
avoid_when: You prefer hand-written network clients and data classes
Your project does not use OpenAPI/Swagger specifications
strengths: Supports OpenAPI v2, v3.0, and v3.1 in both JSON and YAML formats
Supports popular serializers including freezed, json_serializable, and dart_mappable
Allows generation from remote links or local files
Configurable options for custom naming rules, path filtering, and multiple schemes
weaknesses: Requires running a generator tool whenever the OpenAPI specification changes
Generated code tightly couples the app structure to the provided schema
data.setup_notes: Add the package and desired serializers to your dependencies, configure parameters in pubspec.yaml or swagger_parser.yaml, and run 'dart run swagger_parser'.

alternatives.name: retrofit
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer writing your REST client annotations manually instead of generating them from an OpenAPI schema.

data.minimal_example:
swagger_parser:
  schema_path: schemes/openapi.json
  output_directory: lib/api
  json_serializer: json_serializable
